paite: Elisha in, "TOUPA thu na za un. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Zingchiang hiai hun ding vel in Samaria kulh kongpi bul ah tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat in akhawng ding ua, barli buh tehna nih shekel khat in," chi in agen hi.
heading: Elisha Thugenkholhna
english: Elisha said, “Hear Yahweh’s word. Yahweh says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”

paite: Heutu khat kumpipa'n akhut angaknapa'n Pathian mipa adawng hi. "Ngai in, TOUPA'N van ah tohlette bawl leh leng hiai bang ahi thei mahmah dia hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Ngai in, na mit in na mu dia, himahleh na ne kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if Yahweh made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

paite: Huai lai in kulh lutna kongpi bul ah phak li a-om uhi. Amau, "Bangziak a sih ngak lel a tu nilouh i hi ua?
heading: Siria Sepaihte Apaikhia Uh
english: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?

paite: Khopi sung ah lut ni, chi leng, khopi sung kial a, huai a va si mai ding hang a; hiai ah tu nilouh lehang lah si thouthou ding hang a; huaiziak in tu in pai ni in Siria sepaihte kiang ah i va lut peuhmah ding uh. Ahon na hinghawi uh leh i hing dia; ahon na thah uleh si i himai ke," chi in akihou uhi,
english: If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now therefore come, and let’s surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.”

paite: Huchi in Siriate giahphual a hoh ding in khomui in akuan uhi. Siriate giahphual tuah masak ava tun un, ngai in, kuamah ana om kei uhi.
english: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.

paite: TOUPA'N Siria sepaihte kangtalaite husa, sakolte husa leh sepaih tampi husa ana zasak hi. Huchi in "Ngai un, Israel kumpipa'n Hit kumpipate leh Aigupta kumpipate ei hong dou dia guai ei ve,” chi in akihou uhi.
english: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, “Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”

paite: Huchi in athou ua, khomui in ataikekta uh. Apuaninte uh, asakolte uh, asabiltungte uh leh agiahphual uh a-om ngeingei in ataisan ua, ataikekta uhi.
english: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

paite: Huai mi phakte giahphual tuah masak ava tun un puanin khat ah alut ua, ne in adawn uh. Dangkasik, dangka-eng leh puansilhte ala ua, asel ua; anungkik nawn ua, puanin dang ah alut nawn ua, huai leng ala ua, asel uhi.
english: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.

paite: "Aden chiang in, i hihdik het kei. Tuni tanchin kipahhuai tun ni ahi a, ei i daih dide ua; khovak i ngak uleh gawtna i tuak ding uh. Huaiziak in kisa ni, kumpipa inkote i va hilh ding uh," chỉ in akihou uhi.
english: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”

paite: Huchi in khopi kongkhak vengmi ava sam ua, "Siriate giahphual ah ka va hoh ua, ngai in, kuamah ana om kei ua, mihing husa himhim leng a-om kei, sakolte leh sabiltungte kia ana kikhih a, puaninte leng a-om ngeingei in ana om uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”

paite: Kongkhak veng mite asam a; amau kumpipa insung a mite ava hilh uh.
english: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king’s household within.

paite: Zan in kumpipa athou a, asikhate kiang ah, "Siriate hon bawldan ka hon hilh ding. I gilkialdan uh athei uh. Huaiziak in khopi a pan ahong pawt uleh ahing in i na man ding ua, khosung ah i lut ding uh, chi in gamlak a kibu dia agiahphual uh pawtkhiaksan ahi uh," achi hi.
english: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”

paite: Asikhate lak a khat in adawng a, "Khopi a omsun sakol nga va pisak inla, ngai in, Israel mipi adam lai tengteng Israel mipite si bang a sehte ahi himhim uhi; huchi in amaute sawl in enkhe ni," achi hi.
english: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”

paite: Huchi in kangtalai kai sakol nih api ua; kumpipa'n, "Va en dih ua," chi in Siria sepaihte delh ding in asawl hi.
english: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”

paite: Jordan lui pha in ava delh ua; ngai in, Siriate'n akin ziak ua apaih uh puansilhte leh vante, lamtawn in a-om zelzul hi. Huchi in amisawlte ahong kik nawn ua, kumpipa ahong hilh uhi.
english: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king.

paite: Huchi in mipi apawtkhia ua, Siriate giahphual ava lok uhi. Huchi in TOUPA thu bang ngei in tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat in akhong ua, barli buh tehna nih shekel khat mah in.
english: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: Kumpipa'n sepaih heutu, akhut angaknapa kulh kongpi vengmi in asep hi. Mipite'n akulh kongpi bul ah achil uhi, Pathian mipa'n akiang a kumpipa ahong paisuk lai a, ana gen bang in asita hi.
english: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian mipa'n kumpipa kiang a, Zingchiang hichih hun ding vel in Samaria kulh kongpi bul ah, "Barli buh tehna nih shekel khat in akhong ding ua, tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat mah in," achih a;
english: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;”

paite: sepaih heutu in Pathian mipa adawng a, "Ngai in, TOUPA'N van ah tohlette bawlleh leng, huchibang ahi thei dia hia?" achih a, ama'n, "Ngai in, na mit in na mu ngei dia, himahleh na ne kei ding," achih bang in;
english: and that captain answered the man of God, and said, “Now, behold, if Yahweh made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

paite: huchibang in atung ah ahong tungta hi; mipi'n kulh kongpi bul a achil ziak un asita hi.
english: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.
